title: HiPPT: Physiology-Grounded Wearable PPG Representation Learning via Multi-Scope Text Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.14489v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reusable wearable PPG representations should capture local pulse morphology and broader physiological regularities. Existing pretraining objectives, however, usually apply supervision at the recording or pair level, overlooking that different concepts become reliable over different scopes of waveform evidence. We propose HiPPT, a physiology-grounded framework that matches each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope. We construct a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users, pairing recordings with waveform-derived morphology and metadata-derived context descriptions. HiPPT combines record-level morphology alignment, which grounds individual recordings in pulse characteristics, with cross-recording context alignment, which aggregates recordings sharing the same metadata tuple to capture context-consistent regularities. translated_title: HiPPT：基于多范围文本对齐的生理学基础可穿戴PPG表征学习
translated_abstract: 可复用的可穿戴PPG表征应当既能捕获局部脉搏形态，又能捕获更广泛的生理规律。然而，现有的预训练目标通常在记录或配对层面施加监督，忽略了不同概念需要在不同范围的波形证据上才会变得可靠。我们提出了HiPPT，一个以生理学为基础的框架，将每种监督源与其 appropriate 的证据范围相匹配。我们构建了一个包含来自20.2万名用户的超过400万条腕部穿戴记录的PPG-Text语料库，将记录与源自波形的形态描述以及源自元数据的上下文描述进行配对。HiPPT结合了记录级形态对齐（将单个记录锚定于脉搏特征）与跨记录上下文对齐（聚合共享相同元数据元组的记录，以捕获上下文一致的规律性）。波形引导的文本建模进一步从被掩码的上下文中恢复相关概念……
tldr: 提出HiPPT框架，通过将不同监督源匹配到合适的波形证据范围——结合记录级形态对齐与跨记录上下文对齐，并利用400多万条腕部PPG记录构建的PPG-Text语料库进行预训练，实现生理学基础的可穿戴PPG表征学习。
en_tdlr: HiPPT is a physiology-grounded framework that learns wearable PPG representations by matching each supervision source to its appropriate evidence scope, combining record-level morphology alignment with cross-recording context alignment over a PPG-Text corpus of over 4 million wrist-worn recordings from 202K users.
